contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 4450 on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4450) AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report' (4450) — three printed figures, all agreeing
contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 50.00 + 3400.00 = 4,450.00 exactly = all three printed contribution figures. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 15,228 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment. IN-KIND: row 3 (Kathleen Cox, 3,400) has its In-Kind box TICKED and is INSIDE the stated 4,450 — monetary-only was tested and gives 1,050.00, which fails; monetary-plus-in-kind closes exactly. The cover ladder corroborates independently: A 713.23 + B 4450 = F 5163.23 as printed, and F - D = 5163.23 - 4464.55 = 698.68 = the printed Box G.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 4464.55 on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4,464.55) AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' (4,464.55)
expenditures.detail: 13 Schedule B rows sum to 24.67 x 6 (= 148.02) + 52.00 + 7.95 + 34.10 + 14.00 + 20.00 + 788.48 + 3400.00 = 4,464.55 exactly = all three printed expenditure figures. Box E YTD prints 14529.32 and is CUMULATIVE, never summed. No In-Kind box is ticked on this side, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind are identical here and both close. NOTE the 3,400 'Blip / billboard' expenditure on 10/22 mirrors the 3,400 IN-KIND contribution from Kathleen Cox on Schedule A — the same offsetting-pair shape as the Bill Lee filing in this chunk — but here the tick appears only on the contribution row; both sides were reconciled independently and neither was used to interpret the other.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-plus-in-kind on the CONTRIBUTION side (Box B 4450 includes the 3,400 in-kind gift; monetary-only gives 1,050 and fails), and not applicable on the expenditure side (no box ticked, both conventions identical). Tested per filing and per side, never inherited: this is the THIRD distinct in-kind treatment in this one chunk — Bill Lee b3396f89 counts in-kind INSIDE both stated totals, Brandon Gordon 41d9da94 keeps it on a separate sheet OUTSIDE the stated total, and this filing counts it inside on one side only. ADDENDUM G1, demonstrated three ways.

itemized.notes: ⚠ THIS FILER IS THE CHUNK-BRIEF'S NAMED CHECKLIST-DECOY CONTROL CASE, and this filing is the OTHER half of it: `2022_Cox_Hyrum_5.9.2022` p5 is the checklist while `2022_Cox_Hyrum_4.1.2022` p5 is a genuine Summary Page. THE FILING IN THIS CHUNK IS NEITHER — it is 4 pages with NO checklist bound in at all: p1 COVER, p2 SCHEDULE A, p3 SCHEDULE B, p4 SUMMARY PAGE LAST, each classified from its own printed heading. So Hyrum Cox's 2022 filings now show three different page-5/page-4 outcomes across the cycle, which is the sharpest possible confirmation that page position distinguishes nothing and only CONTENT does. FORM: modern_boxAF, 'Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates', Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor masthead, NO printed 'v.' revision string, close box LETTERED 'G', a REAL Purpose column on Schedule B and an In-Kind tick column on both schedules — the unversioned 2022 stock. BORN-DIGITAL fillable form, printed and rescanned; every figure is machine type. PUNCTUATION IS INCONSISTENT AND PRESERVED: Box B is '4450' and Box E '14529.32' with no thousands separator while Box C is '15,228' and the schedule figures '1,000' / '3,400' / '4,464.55' carry one; B and C carry no cents. Nothing was normalised. DATES: Schedule B's whole date column is bare M/D with no year, and Schedule A's date column is entirely EMPTY — every row on both sides carries needs_review=1 for that reason and NO year was ever filled in from the report date. REDACTION IS UPSTREAM AND PER-CELL: the county blacked out the whole Address/City/State/Zip strip and the signature block on the cover, but LEFT THE PHONE NUMBER AND EMAIL IN THE CLEAR on the same page. The bars are the document, not a failed read; nothing behind them was reconstructed and no address or phone was transcribed. Donor city/state on Schedule A come from the form's own 'City and State' column, which prints no street line at all. COVER: page-face candidate 'Hyrum Cox', office typed 'Sheriff' (index.csv carries 'County Sheriff' — the same office, worded differently; the page face is recorded as printed). Report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; Date and Date of Filing both 10/31/2022, agreeing with the 'Date of Report' box on all three inner sheets. Both sides close EXACTLY on three printed figures each, and the whole cover ladder closes too.
